parts.t: Welcome to Bolivar Heights! This 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers charm, comfort, and serious potential. Held by the same owners for years, it features stunning panoramic views of the Fraser River and surrounding mountains. The main floor offers three generous bedrooms with brand-new carpeting, while the lower level includes a fourth bedroom plus a large entertainment area—ideal for a future secondary suite. Major updates include a newer roof (2019), updated windows (2021), and a modern hot water tank. Situated on a spacious 7,183 sq. ft. lot with convenient access to Hwy 1 & 17, SkyTrain, bus stops, SFU Surrey, Kwantlen Polytechnic University, Surrey Central shopping, and nearby parks. Move-in ready with exciting future potential and plenty of room to add value down the road.
